Faithfulness & Hallucination Papers

DUTIR, Reflective RAG, 5ting, CoRAG, CoopRAG, CalibRAG - Faithfulness guards, self-evaluation, evidence-constrained generation, calibration

## Paper Summaries ### DUTIR: Hybrid Retrieval + Faithfulness Guard | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | DUTIR at SemEval-2026 Task 8: A Hybrid Retrieval and Faithfulness-Guarded Framework for Multi-Turn RAG | | **Venue** | SemEval 2026 (ACL Anthology: 2026.semeval-1.48) | | **Key Innovation** | Confidence-based answerability gating + hybrid retrieval (BGE-M3 + BM25 + RRF) | **Key Claims**: - **Pipeline**: 1. LLM query rewriting (GPT-5.2) → resolve conversational dependencies 2. Hybrid retrieval: BGE-M3 + BM25 → RRF 3. **Confidence-based answerability gating** → minimizes hallucination 4. Faithfulness-guarded generation - **Trade-off**: Over-conservative → unwarranted "I Don't Know" for partially answerable queries **Relevance to Our Fix**: - Our `get_evidence_threshold()` = per-subspace confidence gating - DUTIR validates: **confidence-based gating reduces hallucination** - Our `FAITH_GUARD_MIN_SCORE = 0.5` = similar to confidence gating --- ### Reflective RAG: Self-Evaluation Driven Strategy | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | Reflective RAG: Self-Evaluation Driven Strategy Optimization in Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation | | **Venue** | ACL 2026 Findings (ACL Anthology: 2026.findings-acl.648) | | **Key Innovation** | Self-evaluation tagging → RL strategy optimization | **Key Claims**: - **Problem**: Agentic RAG lacks capacity to evaluate retrieved info utility → brittle reasoning - **Solution**: 1. **Reflection tagging**: Model critiques relevance of retrieved content 2. **Two-stage training**: SFT (reflection signals) → RL (strategy optimization with dynamic KL) - **Results**: Outperforms strong agentic baselines on 5 knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks **Relevance**: Our faith guard = simplified reflection (coverage + score check). Reflective RAG shows **explicit self-evaluation** improves robustness. --- ### 5ting: Evidence-Constrained Generation + IDK-Conditioned Scoring | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | 5ting at SemEval-2026 Task 8: Strong End-to-End Multi-Turn RAG via LLM-Based Reranking and Faithfulness Control | | **Venue** | SemEval 2026 | | **Key Innovation** | Evidence-constrained generation + IDK-conditioned harmonic mean | **Key Claims**: - **Evidence-constrained generation**: Only generate if evidence supports - **IDK-conditioned harmonic mean**: Harmonic mean of quality and faithfulness, conditioned on "I Don't Know" rate - **Pipeline**: Dense retrieval → FAISS → LLM reranking → Evidence-constrained generation **Relevance**: Our `FAITH_GUARD_MIN_SCORE = 0.5` + `FAITH_GUARD_MIN_COVERAGE = 0.20` = simplified evidence constraint. --- ### CoRAG: Chain-of-Retrieval Augmented Generation | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | CoRAG: Chain-of-Retrieval Augmented Generation | | **Venue** | NeurIPS 2025 (Poster) | | **Key Innovation** | Iterative retrieval + reasoning chains (o1-like RAG) | **Key Claims**: - **CoRAG**: Teaches LLMs to conduct iterative retrieval + reasoning step-by-step - **Mechanism**: Dynamic query reformulation based on evolving state - **Training**: Rejection sampling to generate intermediate retrieval chains - **Results**: > SOTA on multi-hop QA, KILT benchmark **Relevance**: Our T1+T2 fallback cascade = simplified multi-step retrieval. CoRAG shows **iterative retrieval+reasoning** for complex queries. --- ### CoopRAG: Cooperative Retrieval + LLM Encoder | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | Cooperative Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Question Answering | | **Venue** | NeurIPS 2025 | | **Key Innovation** | Retriever + LLM fine-tuned encoder → mutual information exchange + contrastive ranking | **Key Claims**: - **CoopRAG**: Retriever + LLM fine-tuned encoder cooperate - **Mechanism**: Unrolling-augmented retrieval (UAR) + token-level embeddings - **Results**: +5.3% on multi-hop QA, +35.2% on simple QA vs SOTA **Relevance**: Our KB retrieval + Gemma generation = separate components. CoopRAG shows **tight coupling** improves performance. --- ### CalibRAG: Calibrated Retrieval-Augmented Generation | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | Reliable Decision-Making via Calibration-Oriented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (CalibRAG) | | **Venue** | NeurIPS 2025 | | **Key Innovation** | Calibrated confidence scores for retrieved documents | **Key Claims**: - **Problem**: RAG decisions uncalibrated → unreliable - **Solution**: Calibrated Retrieval → rerank by predicted confidence - **Mechanism**: Sort documents by predicted confidence, not similarity score - **Results**: Improves calibration + accuracy across datasets **Relevance**: Our `_top_evidence_score()` = simplified confidence. CalibRAG shows **calibrated confidence** improves decision-making. --- ## Faithfulness Approaches Comparison | Paper | Mechanism | Guard Type | Training | Our Equivalent | |-------|-----------|------------|----------|----------------| | **DUTIR** | Confidence gating | Answerability gate | GPT-5.2 rewrite | `get_evidence_threshold()` | | **Reflective RAG** | Self-evaluation tags | Reflection + RL | SFT + RL | Faith guard (simplified) | | **5ting** | Evidence constraint + IDK | IDK-conditioned harmonic mean | LLM rerank | `FAITH_GUARD_MIN_SCORE` | | **CoRAG** | Iterative retrieval-reasoning | Chain-of-retrieval | Rejection sampling | T1+T2 cascade (simplified) | | **CoopRAG** | Cooperative retriever+encoder | Mutual info + contrastive | Fine-tuned encoder | Separate retriever/generator | | **CalibRAG** | Calibrated confidence | Confidence rerank | Calibration training | `_top_evidence_score()` | --- ## Our Faith Guard Implementation ```python # format_response.py FAITH_GUARD_MIN_SCORE = 0.5 FAITH_GUARD_MIN_COVERAGE = 0.20 async def format_response(state): # ... generation ... # F: Faith/Hall guard on weak-evidence answers if (state.get("fallback_used") or state.get("broaden_used")) and ABSTENTION_PHRASE not in content: used_top = _top_evidence_score(chosen_chunks) coverage = _token_coverage(content, chosen_chunks) if used_top < FAITH_GUARD_MIN_SCORE and coverage < FAITH_GUARD_MIN_COVERAGE: log.info(f"Faith guard fired: coverage={coverage:.3f} top={used_top:.3f}") content = NO_EVIDENCE_MSG citations = [] faith_refused = True ``` ### Coverage Metric ```python def _token_coverage(answer, chunks): a_tokens = set(answer.split()) if not a_tokens: return 1.0 corpus = " ".join(c.get("content", "") for c in chunks) c_tokens = set(corpus.split()) return len(a_tokens & c_tokens) / len(a_tokens) if c_tokens else 0.0 ``` --- ## Benchmark Delta | Metric | Before | After | Note | |--------|--------|-------|------| | Hallucination | 0.195 | **0.254** | +0.059 (tradeoff) | | Non-hallucination | 0.805 | **0.746** | Tradeoff for recall | | G5 refusal | ✅ | ✅ | Maintained | | Cheque T3 citations | 0 | **5** | Fixed (lexical guard) | | Facilities T3 citations | 0 | **5** | Fixed (lexical guard) | --- ## Architecture: Faith Guard Flow ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Retrieved Chunks] --> B{Strong Evidence?} B -->|No| C{fallback_used or broaden_used?} C -->|Yes| D[Compute top_score + coverage] C -->|No| E[Normal Generation] D --> F{top_score < 0.5 AND coverage < 0.20?} F -->|Yes| G[REPLACE with NO_EVIDENCE_MSG
citations=[]] F -->|No| E E --> H[Generate Answer] H --> I[Return] G --> I style G fill:#fef2f2,stroke:#ef4444 style C fill:#fef3e0,stroke:#f57f17 ``` --- ## Related Pages - [Problem: Hallucination Control](../problems/hallucination.html) - [Paper: Retrieval Fusion & RRF](./retrieval-fusion.html) - [Paper: Subspace Filtering](./subspace-filtering.html) - [Architecture: Faith Guard](../architectures.html#faith-guard)
